m.q: A photographer carries equipment between locations. Explain one advantage and one disadvantage of choosing an SSD instead of an HDD. [4 marks]
st: The drive will travel often and hold large files.
SSD has no moving parts and is more resistant to impacts; access can also be faster.
An SSD may cost more per GB than an HDD; justify one trade-off. [4]

w: Choose storage for a large, low-cost archive that is rarely moved. Explain your choice. [4]
Magnetic HDD is suitable [1] for high capacities [1] at relatively low cost per GB [1]; slower access may be acceptable for infrequent use [1].
A school sends files on DVDs. Identify the technology and explain a limitation. [3]
Optical storage [1]; the disc is read using a laser [1] and may have limited capacity compared with modern SSDs or HDDs [1].
Explain why an SSD might be suitable for a moving laptop. [3]
No moving parts [1] improves resistance to shocks [1], and fast read/write times [1] suit regular use.

k.q: Predict the number of 500 MB files that fit in 2000 MB.
k.code:
capacityMB = 2000
fileMB = 500
files = capacityMB DIV fileMB
print(files)
p: Extend to calculate remaining MB using MOD.
k.a: Prints 4, then 5. Remaining MB = capacityMB MOD fileMB (0 in both cases).
